review_pass_1.status: Completed internal scientific and scope review
changes: Expanded all 11 mapped sections from 5,792 to over 13,000 genuine words without introducing procedural virus replication or transformation guidance.

Verified indexed landmark reports: Epstein/Achong/Barr (1964), Stehelin et al. (1976), Beasley et al. (1981), Dyson et al. (1989), Scheffner et al. (1990); verified IARC HPV and episomal HPV16 evidence, EBV latency review, HBV/HCV references and NCI prevention information.

Removed four redundant historical paragraphs. Retained focused prerequisites rather than repeating viral entry and life cycle. Corrected HCV RNA genome question to avoid implying HBV requires integration.

Redesigned six original SVGs for regulatory polarity, alternative p53 responses, E6/E7 distinct effects, latency patterns, nonobligatory injury/repair recurrence and hypothetical denominator bars; verified titles, descriptions, target IDs and source coordinates.

review_pass_2.status: Completed internal teaching and assessment review
changes: Added 10 Part B, 10 Part C and 10 mixed original questions; revised two redundant/moderate items and corrected an ambiguity. Checked keys against all four answer choices.
Added two worked examples and a second evidence comparison table. Audited saved HTML, scripts syntax, figures, counts, anchors and reader link patterns.

Compared actual saved 4.E.06 (14057 words) and 4.D.08 (13644 words). Lexical similarity screen is not proof of semantic originality; closest prerequisite overlap is the required HPV mechanism refresher. Narrative retains focus on the cancer-specific significance.
